_comment: Hosts that must not be opened in the IN-APP Browser pane (mcp__Claude_Browser__*).
Read by hooks/browser_pane_scope_guard.py; a listed host also covers its subdomains.
Nothing writes this file automatically - adding an entry is a deliberate act, so the
list stays small and its false-positive rate stays at zero. Add a host only after a
pane-adjacent crash whose last navigation is attributable (telemetry/browser-nav.jsonl
plus the 'GPU process gone' line in %APPDATA%\Claude\logs\main.log).
Out-of-process routes (WebFetch, claude-in-chrome, headless Playwright) are unaffected.
